evidence.AC1: POST /todos with {"title":"past","dueDate":"2026-10-01"} returned 201 with dueDate "2026-10-01". POST without a dueDate returned 201 with dueDate null. The value is a plain YYYY-MM-DD date with no time.
evidence.AC2: PATCH /todos/2 {"dueDate":"2026-09-01"} returned 200 and the due date changed from 2026-12-01 to 2026-09-01. PATCH {"dueDate":null} returned 200 and dueDate became null.
evidence.AC3: POST with dueDate "2026-02-30", "15.10.2026" and the number 20261015 each returned 400. PATCH with "2026-02-30" and "x" each returned 400.
evidence.AC4: With today = 2026-10-15, GET /todos?overdue=true returned only the not-done todo due 2026-10-01 (id 1) and, after the PATCH, id 2 due 2026-09-01. The todo due today, the todo due 2026-12-01, the todo with no due date and the done todo due 2026-10-01 were excluded. After id 2's due date was removed, the filter returned only id 1.
evidence.AC5: The page at / listed "past 2026-10-01", "future" (no date shown, because its due date had been removed by that point), "today 2026-10-15" and "pastdone ✓ 2026-10-01". Each todo with a due date shows it.
evidence.AC6: In the page snapshot only the not-done todo "past" (due 2026-10-01) carried the word "überfällig". The todos due today or in the future, the todo without a due date and the done todo with a past due date had no mark.
evidence.AC7: The page has a checkbox labelled "nur überfällige". After I clicked it, the list showed only "past 2026-10-01 überfällig".
